source_snapshot.procedure: Run read-only badblocks before/after, then stress all SSDs simultaneously with sequential read, sequential write, random read and random write for 15 minutes each, repeating the one-hour group at nine block sizes; generic setup clears logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: SUT remains workable, no bad blocks after stress and no system-event errors.
source_snapshot.script: No Script; 30 attended and 1080 machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; hardcodes /dev/nvme1n1, uses password-bearing host-key-unsafe SSH, inspects only truncated identity/SMART fields and does not implement all-device concurrency, nine sizes, postchecks or safe write boundaries.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION at CRITICAL risk; exact E1.S population, isolated devices/ranges, resolved timing, aggregate limits, immutable per-device evidence and recovery are mandatory.

old_problem: The procedure's four 15-minute phases equal one hour per block size and therefore nine hours across the listed sizes, but Machine Time is 1080 minutes (18 hours) and no second pass or dwell explains the extra nine hours. 'All SSD' is also not an executable target set: no E1.S serial/slot/namespace ledger or safe range is supplied. DeepSeek reduces the population test to one mutable device path and omits the actual workload, making both coverage and target safety unverifiable.
disposition_reason: Retain Engineering Decision Pending and Source Conflict for the formal duration only. The complete installed E1.S population can be a runtime Project Configuration Requirement under ED-04, so missing serials alone do not keep the review pending. However, ED-16 preserves the formal long-duration coverage and does not authorize doubling or shortening exposure when Procedure and Machine Time disagree. Official fio semantics support a deterministic synchronized nine-size matrix, and official nvme-cli logs support per-controller/namespace health evidence, but neither authority explains the source's unallocated second nine hours. The review therefore supplies a complete parameterized multi-device testcase while reserving exactly one owner ruling: nine or 18 hours and, if 18, the defined second phase/pass.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1767, same-row DeepSeek/test-json content, GPT V2, historical V3.1 record, original pending/conflict analyses, duplicate-code result and ED rules were read. The next missing formal queue identity was reconstructed from the locked manifest and directly opened as Functionality row 1769 / Wistron-HW-00402-V003 / 69943ca89a6c10ff.

This row is independently scoped to E1.S and must not inherit the preceding M.2 row's target, range, duration or evidence. ED-02 and ED-20 preserve both Source Keys even where their storage-stress shapes are similar.

Four 15-minute modes equal the Procedure's one hour per block size; nine listed sizes yield nine hours. The 1080-minute machine estimate is 18 hours, and the source specifies no repeat count, second target group, media-scan allowance or dwell that accounts for the difference. Exposure/endurance cannot be synthesized.

'All SSD' is safely parameterizable as every owner-designated installed E1.S serial/slot/namespace in a signed population ledger. Each member still needs its own disposable-device or exact LBA range proof; enumeration order or one `/dev/nvme1n1` is not an acceptable proxy.

fio's official documentation supports explicit per-job filename, offset, size, runtime/time_based and grouped abort/report behavior. Concurrent execution must retain separate device outputs plus a shared phase timeline so one failing or disappearing E1.S cannot be hidden in aggregate statistics.

nvme-cli documents namespace-selectable SMART and error log collection. Pre/post deltas are required per E1.S controller/namespace and must be correlated with PCIe slot/BDF, temperature and platform events; command success alone is not acceptance.
The shown badblocks options are read-only by default. They remain pre/post read coverage only; no -n/-w substitution, mounted-device override or destructive whole-device scan is inferred.
No fio, badblocks, disk write, log clear or other DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: E1.S population stress — synchronized per-device matrix with owner-resolved formal duration
test_case.purpose: Exercise every owner-designated E1.S NVMe target simultaneously through the source's four 15-minute sequential/random read/write modes at all nine block sizes for the formally approved schedule, while protecting every device range and proving both per-device and shared PCIe/power/thermal/platform health.
required_package: Engineering ruling selecting the literal nine-hour Procedure or 18-hour Machine Time; if 18 hours, an exact approved definition of the additional pass, phase or dwell
Signed E1.S population ledger with SUT, chassis slot, model, serial/WWN, controller/namespace, firmware and PCIe BDF/link for every in-scope device
Per-device disposable status or exact owner-signed aligned offset/size range, capacity and complete partition/mount/swap/LVM/RAID/device-mapper/data-ownership proof
Pinned fio, nvme-cli, smartmontools, e2fsprogs/badblocks and util-linux versions; immutable per-device job files and synchronized phase controller

Maintenance/destructive-write approval, workload drain, endurance budget, aggregate PCIe/power/thermal limits, group and per-device abort thresholds, backup/restore, independent console/BMC and recovery owner
test_case.test_command: NOT STARTED; destructive approval required. After the duration ruling, enumerate the signed E1.S population by serial/WWN/slot/controller/namespace/BDF and prove each target is disposable or that its exact aligned offset/size excludes every OS, boot, swap, filesystem, LVM, RAID, device-mapper and valid-data extent. Preserve baseline and generate one reviewed fio job per device for each shared phase, retaining sequential read/write and random read/write, 15 minutes per mode and all nine block sizes, plus any separately defined owner-approved second pass needed for an 18-hour ruling. Validate jobs without I/O, obtain immediate approval for every serial, then start the population in synchronized bounded phases with separate full output and a common timeline. Monitor per-device NVMe health/error/temperature and aggregate PCIe, power, cooling, kernel and BMC state; stop the coordinated group on any safety fault. Perform only the approved read-only pre/post badblocks/media read on each proven target. Preserve logs; no mutable-path selection, log clear, automatic retry, unruled extra pass or reduced smoke run.
test_case.expected_result: Every E1.S in the signed population completes each approved mode/block-size phase exactly once, or the specifically ruled 18-hour extension, against only its proven range, with synchronized start/end evidence and no target dropout or cross-range I/O. Every device has no new unreadable block, unacceptable critical-warning/media/error/endurance/temperature delta or PCIe degradation; shared power/cooling/PCIe and OS/BMC events stay within approved limits; protected data, workload and the final SUT remain intact and workable.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Review remains PENDING only until the nine-versus-18-hour schedule is signed. Runtime serials and ranges are prerequisites, not new engineering questions. After binding, PASS requires 100% of the signed E1.S population and every required phase/size with separate immutable evidence, approved per-device and aggregate thresholds, and a healthy final state. One sampled device, merged output, nine hours when 18 was ruled, an unexplained duplicate pass, or a smoke subset cannot pass. Wrong/missing target, range escape, phase omission, I/O error/hang, device/link dropout, new bad block, unacceptable health/thermal/event delta or integrity failure is reported for engineer FAIL/BLOCKED disposition; the end user decides the verdict.
safety_gate: Re-resolve every serial/WWN/slot/namespace/BDF before each phase; fail closed on population, topology or range drift. Never infer 'all SSD' from `/dev/nvme1n1` or enumeration order.

Never write OS, boot, swap, filesystem, LVM, RAID/member, device-mapper, mounted, production or valid-data extents. Require exact capacity-bounded offset/size ownership proof per target and immediate destructive approval per serial.

Limit per-device jobs and aggregate queue, power, temperature and PCIe load to owner thresholds. Retain monitoring/recovery capacity and use a coordinated group stop when any member or shared platform limit fails.
Keep badblocks read-only unless separately authorized; do not add -n/-w, override in-use safeguards or substitute a whole-device test for an unproven range. Preserve rather than clear all logs.
On wrong target, dropout, I/O/health/thermal/power/link/event fault or evidence loss, stop all jobs without retry. Do not repair, remount, reset, reboot or power-cycle automatically.
expected_evidence: Source Key/Variant, duration ruling and any 18-hour extension definition, signed population/concurrency matrix, maintenance/write approval and tool versions
Per-device serial/WWN/slot/controller/namespace/firmware/BDF/link, capacity and ownership maps with disposable status or exact aligned range proof
Immutable fio jobs and separate stdout/stderr/exit status/start/end/duration for every device, mode and block size plus synchronized group timeline and no-retry/range audit
Per-device pre/during/post NVMe SMART and error logs, temperature/endurance, PCIe link and read-only media scan, plus aggregate power/cooling/kernel/BMC/system events
Per-device and overall data/workload integrity, final SUT readiness, recovery actions and engineer-owned PENDING/PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED verdict
test_case.recovery: If any member has wrong identity/range, I/O hang/error, dropout, media/health growth, thermal/power/link alarm, evidence loss or integrity mismatch, stop the synchronized population and preserve every device's phase position, job/output, LBA scope, health and shared timeline. Do not retry or reset the failed device or remaining group. The storage/platform owner isolates each affected namespace, restores data or replaces hardware under the approved plan, performs vendor diagnostics and coordinates PCIe/backplane/power/cooling recovery before any device or workload is released.

source_conflict.reason: The literal Procedure is nine hours, while Machine Time is 18 hours and no defined second pass/phase accounts for the difference. The target population is parameterizable, but the authoritative exposure remains an unresolved acceptance conflict.

blocked.reason: The E1.S population, ranges and aggregate limits are concrete runtime inputs and the complete safe workflow is defined. One duration ruling enables execution, so the case remains REQUIRES rather than irreducibly BLOCKED.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Engineering ruling for nine-hour Procedure versus 18-hour Machine Time and definition of any additional 18-hour coverage; runtime E1.S serial/slot/namespace ledger, safe ranges, concurrency/aggregate limits, thresholds, maintenance/write approval and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW COMPLETE BUT ENGINEERING DECISION PENDING; EXECUTION NOT STARTED; NO FIO, BADBLOCKS, STORAGE WRITE, LOG CLEAR, RETRY OR OTHER DUT ACTION AUTHORIZED OR EXECUTED

external_authorities.application: Documents time_based/runtime, per-job reporting and grouped termination controls needed for synchronized bounded multi-device phases; does not select the source's formal duration.
Documents device and namespace-selectable SMART log retrieval for per-target pre/post health evidence.
Documents namespace and LBA-aware error-log retrieval for device-specific error deltas and diagnosis.
Confirms default read-only scanning and the distinct destructive semantics of alternate modes; no write-mode escalation is inferred.

project_authority: Engineering owns the nine-versus-18-hour ruling. Storage/platform owners define the E1.S population, safe per-device ranges, thresholds, aggregate resource limits and recovery and approve each destructive target; workload owners authorize outage; the end user decides verdict. AI may validate and orchestrate only the signed matrix and cannot invent the second nine hours or execute writes without approval.
